operating_rule: A directory listing is a research lead, not proof of current operation, contact authorization, partnership interest, licensing or agreement. No target is marked contacted or active until independently verified.
next_execution: Expand the target register country by country and region by region.
Verify official station websites and partnership contacts.
Prepare tailored invitations for radio networks and independent stations.
Record every contact, response, rights review and signed agreement.
Run test audio feeds only after written permission and technical approval.
